notes.title: New Update: Features, Polishes and Bug fixees
notes.notes:
Hey all you ghoul getters,

A new update is live for Unruly Ghouls. This update brings some new features, polishes and bug fixes. You can check out some of the additions in the video below and patch notes are below that.

Happy ghoul blasting!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u9DaZiDWb2I
Feature Additions:

New Feature: Vacuums can now suck up spectral orb power ups
New Feature: Cloaked ghouls now have skulls that can still be damaged. When a ghoul cloaks, a skull is still visible and can be hit, this lets you have a greater challenge when a ghoul is cloaked but you still have a way to damage it.


Tweaks and balance changes:

Increased Common Power Up Value from 1 to 2 and increased Rare Power Up from 3 to 4, this will grant uber and repair power ups more often.
Moved side wards back and inward a bit, this helps from cheap ghosts attack when they attack too close to the side wards giving the player more time to react
Added a satisfying "pop" sound when pulling in a power up or a ghoul.
Sped up vacuum speed of ghouls overall so they are always sucked up faster
Tweaked Orb Trail effect after shooting it or sucking it up with the vacuum to be more like a trail
Adjusted balance on waves 11-15


Bug Fixes:

Fixed Heart HUD meshes blocking vacuum traces on ghouls and orbs
Fixed bug where purple cloaker ghost would not attack if woke up from being stunned in some cases

notes.title: Small Balance Update
notes.notes:
Good morning, a small balance udpate today.

*Tuned back health on ghouls, more health on the cloakers was getting pretty frutstrating ghoul health has been tuned to its original state. 
*Slightly increased speed on minion ghouls when targeting the player
*Improved touchpad weapon switching controls. - Now anywhere you click on the touchpad will swap between your vacuum and blaster.

This update is available now!

notes.title: Thank You And Dual Wielding Update!
notes.notes:
We wanted to say thank you to everyone who has purchased Unruly Ghouls and supported the game so far. It's been a lot of hard work getting here and we are really excited to see the leaderboards lighting up with players.

The global leaderboard is viewable on our Steam community page here : http://steamcommunity.com/stats/523720/leaderboards/1449170/ We'd really like to get this visible in game in the future.

We would also like to announce a new feature and some balance changes. As of today you can now dual wield either the blasters or the vacuums, twice the blasters=twice the fun! Since this gives you some more firepower the balance has been tweaked slightly to increase the challenge.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26552958/11378fc85f0882a075598a7a7a88e974c9207aa0.jpg

We'd love to hear if you think the game is challenging enough or you like the current pace.

Thanks again!

Change list

New Feature - Dual Wielding Blasters or Vacuums

    * Added touchpad controls and UI to change weapon
    * Left on touch pad chooses vaccum
    * Right on touch pad chooses blaster

Set max active ghosts by 1 for all waves (was 4 before wave 10, now 5) (Max active ghosts scales up to 8 if you hit wave 31)
Slight increased speed of minion ghouls to up the base of the game a bit
Increase of ghoul health to help offset the balance of having two guns
